model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.quote: Commencing at the apex of Gnawed Mountain

steps.until: the point of intersection with the reclaim water line due East of Gnawed Lake
steps.quote: thence northerly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the reclaim water line due East of Gnawed Lake

steps.until: the point of intersection with the westerly boundary of Highmont Ultimate Tailings Pond
steps.quote: thence in a general easterly direction along the reclaim water line to the point of intersection with the westerly boundary of Highmont Ultimate Tailings Pond

steps.direction: in a general southeasterly, easterly and northerly direction
steps.until: the point of intersection with the fresh water supply line south of Squetankilhats Indian Reserve 15
steps.quote: thence in a general southeasterly, easterly and northerly direction along the westerly, southerly and easterly boundaries of the said Tailings Pond and a prolongation thereof to the point of intersection with the fresh water supply line south of Squetankilhats Indian Reserve 15

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of the Highland Valley Highway
steps.quote: thence in a general northerly direction along the said water line and a prolongation thereof to the point of intersection with the midline of the Highland Valley Highway

steps.until: the point west of Enquotco Indian Reserve 14 at which the existing gas pipeline crosses the said Highway
steps.quote: thence in a general westerly direction along the midline of the said highway to the point west of Enquotco Indian Reserve 14 at which the existing gas pipeline crosses the said Highway

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Spud Lake at the most easterly point thereof
steps.quote: thence northeasterly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Spud Lake at the most easterly point thereof

steps.until: the most northerly point thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general northerly direction along the natural boundary of Spud Lake to the most northerly point thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Copper Lake at the most easterly point thereof
steps.quote: thence northwesterly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Copper Lake at the most easterly point thereof

steps.until: the most northerly point thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general northerly direction along the natural boundary of Copper Lake to the most northerly point thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Bose Lake at the most southerly point thereof
steps.quote: thence northwesterly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Bose Lake at the most southerly point thereof

steps.until: the most westerly point thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general northwesterly direction along the natural boundary of Bose Lake to the most westerly point thereof

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of the existing secondary road west of Bose Lake
steps.quote: thence northwesterly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the midline of the existing secondary road west of Bose Lake

steps.feature: existing secondary road west of Bose Lake
steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of the existing mining road leading to Forge Mountain
steps.quote: thence in a general westerly direction along the midline of said existing secondary road to the point of intersection with the midline of the existing mining road leading to Forge Mountain

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of Highland Valley Highway north of Chilthnaux Indian Reserve 12 at which the existing powerline crosses the said Highway
steps.quote: thence westerly in a straight line to the point of intersection with the midline of Highland Valley Highway north of Chilthnaux Indian Reserve 12 at which the existing powerline crosses the said Highway

steps.until: the point of intersection with midline of the new Highland Valley Highway
steps.quote: thence in a general westerly direction along the midline of the said Highway to the point of intersection with midline of the new Highland Valley Highway

steps.until: the point of intersection with the old Highland Valley Highway
steps.quote: thence in a general westerly direction along the said new Highway to the point of intersection with the old Highland Valley Highway

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of the existing secondary road leading southeasterly to Pukaist Creek
steps.quote: thence in a southerly direction along the old Highland Valley Highway to the point of intersection with the midline of the existing secondary road leading southeasterly to Pukaist Creek

steps.feature: existing secondary road leading southeasterly to Pukaist Creek
steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of the existing water pipeline
steps.quote: thence southeasterly along the midline of the said existing secondary road to the point of intersection with the midline of the existing water pipeline

steps.direction: in a general easterly and southerly direction
steps.until: the point of intersection with the prolongation of the midline of the existing mining road leading southwesterly to Alwin Mines
steps.quote: thence in a general easterly and southerly direction along the midline of the said existing water pipeline to the point of intersection with the prolongation of the midline of the existing mining road leading southwesterly to Alwin Mines

steps.feature: existing mining road leading southwesterly to Alwin Mines
steps.until: a point one kilometre distant from the active workings of Alwin Mines
steps.quote: thence in a general southwesterly direction along the said prolongation, the midline of the said existing mining road and the southerly prolongation thereof to a point one kilometre distant from the active workings of Alwin Mines

steps.direction: in a general southerly and easterly direction
steps.feature: active workings of Alwin, Valley Copper, Lornex and Highmont Mines
steps.until: the point of commencement
steps.quote: thence in a general southerly and easterly direction along a line at least one kilometre distant from the active workings of Alwin, Valley Copper, Lornex and Highmont Mines to the point of commencement

quotes.quote: contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the apex of Gnawed Mountain
